learning_outcomes.text: Integrate the principles of rationalization of company experiences and knowledge to extract relevant decision-making indicators for decision support in product/process development.
Allow the company to have an overview of knowledge management and decision-making activities.
Reason on perceived information and available knowledge to arrive at adequate, explicable, and convincing decisions.
Master methods for perceiving the environment to capture information useful for the task, such as identifying objects, people, sounds or voices.
Master methods for reasoning on perceived information and available knowledge to arrive at adequate, explicable, and convincing decisions.
Master methods for learning, based on examples and experiences, to better achieve the assigned objective.
Master methods for acting on the environment and interacting with others deliberately, taking into account the task's context.

syllabus_topics: Definition and motivation of decision support
Concepts, principles and methods of decision engineering
Approaches used in decision engineering: Approach taking into account a priori expert knowledge/ Approach integrating experience contained in the data.
Knowledge representation: definition, philosophical and psychological bases, history of the evolution of formalisms.
Types of representation: formal logic, production rules, conceptual graphs.
Various applications of knowledge engineering: semantic web, cooperative work, educational engineering, system design, linguistic engineering, information systems, corporate memories, etc.
